results.text_hl: Various @GENE_CDKN2A @GENE_1029 @@@p16INK4a@@@ mutants, including the @DISEASE_Melanoma @DISEASE_MESH:D008545 @@@melanoma@@@-associated germline mutations @VARIANT_p.A36P_CDKN2A_human @VARIANT_tmVar:p|SUB|A|36|P;HGVS:p.A36P;VariantGroup:21;CorrespondingGene:1029;CorrespondingSpecies:9606 @@@Ala36Pro@@@ and @<m>VARIANT_p.A57V_CDKN2A_human</m> @VARIANT_tmVar:p|SUB|A|57|V;HGVS:p.A57V;VariantGroup:12;OriginalGene:12578;CorrespondingGene:1029;RS#:372266620;CorrespondingSpecies:10090;CA#:350362 @@@Ala57Val@@@, were also associated with impaired oxidative regulatory functions, and intracellular oxidative dysregulation in melanocytes can lead to genetic damage that contributes to increased @DISEASE_Melanoma @DISEASE_MESH:D008545 @@@melanoma@@@ susceptibility.
